headline: India's GDP Growth Hits 7.2% in Q4, Fastest Among G20 Nations
summary: India recorded 7.2% GDP growth in the January–March quarter, outpacing all G20 economies. Strong manufacturing and services sectors drove the surge, while rural consumption showed revival. The IMF raised India's full-year forecast to 6.8%, citing infrastructure investment momentum.

headline: ISRO Successfully Launches Gaganyaan Test Module into Orbit
summary: ISRO completed the crucial uncrewed orbital test of Gaganyaan, India's first human spaceflight mission. The crew module orbited Earth for 3 days before a successful splashdown in the Bay of Bengal. Manned mission now scheduled for late 2027, pending final safety reviews.

headline: RBI Holds Repo Rate at 6.0%, Signals Accommodative Stance for Growth
summary: The Reserve Bank of India kept the repo rate unchanged at 6.0% in its April policy meeting, signaling continued support for economic growth. Governor Das cited easing inflation and stable food prices as key factors behind the decision.

headline: Supreme Court Mandates Environmental Impact Reports for Urban Projects
summary: In a landmark ruling, the Supreme Court directed all state governments to mandate environmental impact assessments for urban development projects exceeding ₹500 crore. The bench cited rising pollution levels and loss of green cover in metro cities.

headline: Global AI Safety Summit Concludes with 28-Nation Accord on Regulation
summary: The 2026 Global AI Safety Summit in Seoul concluded with 28 nations signing a binding accord on AI governance. Key provisions include mandatory safety testing for frontier models, transparency requirements for training data, and cross-border incident reporting frameworks.

headline: IPL 2026: Mumbai Indians Break Record with 11th Consecutive Win
summary: Mumbai Indians secured their 11th straight victory this season, defeating Chennai Super Kings by 42 runs. Jasprit Bumrah took 4 wickets for 18 runs, while Suryakumar Yadav smashed 89 off 47 balls to set a commanding 208-run target.

headline: Cabinet Approves ₹2.5 Lakh Crore Green Hydrogen Mission Phase 2
summary: The Union Cabinet approved Phase 2 of the National Green Hydrogen Mission with ₹2.5 lakh crore allocation over 5 years. India aims to produce 10 million tonnes of green hydrogen annually by 2030, creating an estimated 6 lakh new jobs in the clean energy sector.

headline: UPI Crosses 20 Billion Monthly Transactions for First Time
summary: India's Unified Payments Interface processed over 20 billion transactions in March 2026, worth ₹22.4 lakh crore. UPI now covers 450 million unique users, with Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities driving 58% of new registrations over the past quarter.

headline: Indian Students Win 4 Gold Medals at International Math Olympiad
summary: India's six-member team brought home 4 gold and 2 silver medals at the 2026 International Mathematics Olympiad held in Tokyo, ranking 3rd globally. Arjun Mehta from Hyderabad scored a perfect 42/42, only the 5th Indian to achieve this feat.

headline: WHO Declares India Measles-Free After Decade-Long Vaccination Drive
summary: The World Health Organization officially certified India as measles-free following a 10-year nationwide vaccination campaign that covered 98% of children under 5. India becomes the largest country by population to achieve this milestone.

headline: Tesla Announces ₹7,500 Crore Manufacturing Plant in Gujarat
summary: Tesla confirmed a ₹7,500 crore investment to build its first Indian manufacturing facility near Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The plant will produce Model 2 and Model Y vehicles starting 2028, creating 12,000 direct jobs. Gujarat offered 30-year land lease at subsidized rates.

headline: Chandrayaan-4 Mission Approved: India to Bring Back Lunar Samples
summary: The Indian government approved the ₹2,104 crore Chandrayaan-4 mission, which will attempt to bring back soil samples from the Moon's south pole. Launch is planned for 2028, building on Chandrayaan-3's historic soft landing achievement in 2023.

headline: New Education Policy: Coding Mandatory from Class 3 Across All Schools
summary: MHRD announced that coding and computational thinking will become a mandatory subject starting Class 3 in all CBSE, ICSE, and state board schools from the 2027 academic year. A ₹4,000 crore budget will fund teacher training and digital lab infrastructure.

headline: Indian Rupee Strengthens to ₹78.50 as Foreign Inflows Surge
summary: The rupee appreciated to a 14-month high of ₹78.50 against the US dollar, driven by $8.2 billion in foreign portfolio inflows during April. Strong corporate earnings and declining crude oil prices bolstered market sentiment across Asian currencies.

headline: Delhi Metro Phase 5 Gets Green Signal: 45 New Stations by 2030
summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved Delhi Metro Phase 5 with 3 new corridors spanning 62 km and 45 stations. The ₹37,000 crore project will connect Dwarka Sector 25 to Noida Airport, easing commuter strain on existing lines.
